FFmpeg Third-Party Notice
=========================

This portable package contains an FFmpeg binary obtained from the
FFmpeg installation selected when Setup-FFmpeg-Portable.bat was run.

Project information and source code:
https://ffmpeg.org/

The exact build configuration is recorded in FFMPEG_BUILD_INFO.txt.
Any license files located with the selected build were copied into
tools\licenses\FFmpeg.

ffprobe.exe is intentionally not bundled. The application uses
ffmpeg.exe itself to read media information.
